title: Transforming Cities: The paint cooling Jakarta
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: The paint cooling Jakarta,” an urban initiative documented for Jakarta. It is included because it is located in the Global South. intervention.objectives: Jakarta is home to over 10 million people who seek shelter indoors from the blistering urban heat. One brilliant architecture professor is painting the skyline with a sun-reflecting paint to cool down the city.
intervention.measures:
Indonesia’s bustling capital is home to over 10 million people who seek shelter indoors from the blistering urban heat. But one brilliant architecture professor is painting the skyline with a sun-reflecting paint in a bid to cool down the city.
